newsitem.title: USA: nStor won't meet '97 forecast of $0.20/shr.
newsitem.headline: nStor won't meet '97 forecast of $0.20/shr.

text.p: nStor Technologies Inc said on Friday that it will not meet its previous forecasts earning of $0.20 a share for 1997, because of product delays.

"In light of the delays in completing development of the CR8e and Parity+ product lines, we do not expect full- year earnings to reach previously forecast levels of $0.20 per share," the company said in a statement
In May, the company issued a forecast that it would earn at least $0.20 a share on sales of $45 million.

During the past several months, nStor has devoted a considerable amount of its resources towards re- engineering, enhancing, and certifying selected products acquired from Parity Systems in December 1996.
The resultant new product offerings were officially launched on July 15, 1997 under the Parity+ trade name, nStor said.
The company said its efforts to expand product distribution could generate more revenues in the second half of 1997, as well as new products scheduled for release during the balance of 1997.
